title: Every Day, Your Whole Life Long
story: Keep Your Heart Close to God
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When Solomon had built God's house,
The Lord spoke, kind and true,
"If you obey and follow Me,
I'll bless you through and through."

[Chorus]
Keep your heart close to God each day,
Your whole life, all along.
Not just for now, but grown-up too,
And He will keep you strong.

[Verse 2]
"But if you turn away from Me,
Then things will not go well."
And sadly, when the king grew old,
His heart turned, and he fell.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and whisper low,
"I'll love You all my days."
Heavenly Father's near you now,
And with you all your ways.

[Chorus]
mood: Promise music. A steady, gentle pulse holds under the voice like a hand kept over a heart, calm and constant, matching a promise meant to last a whole life and not just one night. The chorus lifts with quiet resolve, the way a child says "I will" before sleep. By the last verse the pulse slows and settles lower, still constant and still there, as the promise is tucked in and the room goes dark.
